t: The Hager Sollysta WMGF2 2-module grid frame provides a robust foundation for electrical switch and socket installations. This 2-module grid frame is specifically designed for integration with Hager's White Moulded and Decorative Raised Plate ranges. With fixings supplied installation is straightforward, allowing for efficient and secure mounting of electrical accessories.
b: Frames for White Moulded & Decorative Raised Plate Ranges
